stem_book: An adiabatic process is defined as that process in which: (a) energy is transferred as heat (b) no energy is transferred as heat (c) ΔU = w (d) the temp. of gas increases in a reversible adiabatic compression
key: b No energy is transferred as heat
derived: b No energy is transferred as heat
correct_answer: b No energy is transferred as heat
reason: (c) and (d) are also true consequences of an adiabatic process; stem sharpened to ask for the definition so (b) is the single answer
work: adiabatic ⇔ q = 0 (definition); ΔU = w and heating on compression follow from it → (b)
